exposure: spinal surgery for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
outcome: Low back pain during and after pregnancy
cohort: 50 women who underwent surgery for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis between 1984 and 2014 and subsequently became pregnant
finding: Women who underwent spinal fusion for AIS generally had uncomplicated pregnancies and vaginal deliveries, but their access to epidural anesthesia was limited.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate in women with AIS was similar to the general population (19%).
